method: One GNU du -x -B1 --max-depth=5 . traversal; allocated blocks, no symlink following, each hard-linked inode counted once in this traversal. Live non-atomic snapshot. TSV contains overlapping parents and children: never sum all rows.

largest_campaign_file_breakdown.note: File-only allocation; parent directory allocation is separate. Not a reclaimability audit.

sample_redundancy_check.method: NumPy array_equal on sampled phase and trace arrays; omit first row of phases after the first, matching phase-boundary de-duplication. This verifies one sample, not every archive or dependency.

producer_snapshot.scope: Region-model fitting/support, not a new bulk native campaign; additional interactive sessions and dependent audits were present. Other sessions may write concurrently.
